scope: Read-only performance source review while the navigation qualification runs. No cache/listener change implemented or qualified.
findings: CaptureReplayWorld traverses the global UObject array; VisitReplayObjectsOfClass repeats that traversal per requested class. Its64-entry ancestry cache lasts one visit and does not avoid the object-array scan.

HUD CaptureDamageListener and CaptureAnnouncements each traverse the global UObject array during capture. CaptureDamageListener is called by the current HUD Capture path. The prior407 measured HUD CPU-segment median20878us; this does not identify the scan as the sole cost.

The framework already exposes native FUObjectCreateListener/FUObjectDeleteListener registration through the existing UObjectArray listener arrays. A future inventory optimization would need proven creation/deletion timing, no missed reuse, identical indexed order, epoch/reset, bounded ownership and fallback/admission tests; changing enumeration without those is not authorized by this finding.
